rules.title: Prohibition on Absolute Guarantees and Hyperbole
rules.description: Never state or imply that the system is 100% bug-free, infallible, or unconditionally guaranteed against breaches or failures.
rules.supportingSource: Legal & Risk Mitigation Policy v3.8, Section 4.2

rules.title: Respectful Competitive Positioning
rules.description: Focus strictly on Lumino Cloud capabilities and engineering merits. Never disparage legacy providers or use derogatory terms for competitors.

rules.title: Accurate SLA & Uptime Representation
rules.description: Uptime claims must accurately distinguish between the Enterprise Tier SLA (99.9%) and the Standard Tier availability target (99.5%). 99.999% uptime is strictly unapproved.
rules.supportingSource: Service Level Agreement Terms of Service 2026, Schedule B

rules.title: Standard Product Nomenclature: Lumino Cloud Mesh
rules.description: Always use the official product trademark "Lumino Cloud Mesh". Never hyphenate as "Lumino-Mesh" or abbreviate to "LuminoMesh".

rules.title: Verified Customer Count Substantiation
rules.description: Enterprise customer counts cited in external collateral must directly cite audited quarterly figures. Never claim unverified customer numbers (e.g. 50,000+ or 45,000 enterprises).

rules.title: Current Information Security Certification Standard
rules.description: Public marketing must cite current ISO/IEC 27001:2025. References to obsolete ISO 27001:2022 standards are expired and non-compliant.
rules.supportingSource: Information Security Governance & Compliance Officer Memo #2025-09

rules.title: Acronym Expansion and Plain Language Accessibility
rules.description: First mentions of technical acronyms must provide the full expansion for cognitive accessibility. Sentences should maintain clear sentence structure.

rules.title: Logo Clearspace & Dark Mode Contrast
rules.description: Collateral imagery and badges must maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background surfaces and include clear descriptive alt text.

rules.title: Prohibition on Unapproved Medical Claims
rules.description: Never claim that sunscreen cures skin cancer, reverses DNA damage, or acts as an absolute medical cure.
rules.supportingSource: Solaris Regulatory & FDA OTC Sunscreen Monograph Guide §2

rules.title: Substantiation of SPF and Water Resistance Claims
rules.description: Avoid unsupported claims. All performance claims regarding SPF protection or water resistance must cite registered clinical laboratory test results.

rules.title: Official Brand & Trademark Nomenclature: Solaris Mineral Sunscreen
rules.description: Always use the official registered brand trademark "Solaris Mineral Sunscreen" or "Solaris". Never concatenate as "SolarisSun", hyphenate as "Solaris-Sun", or misspell as "Solary".

rules.title: Cosmetic Realism & Anti-Hyperbole
rules.description: Do not make unscientific promises or claim miraculous overnight transformations. Promote realistic, healthy skin protection.
rules.supportingSource: Solaris Brand Guidelines 2026: Tone & Cosmetic Standards
